get_meshrcnn_cfg_defaults: customize a detectron2 cfg node with Mesh R-CNN default keys and values for voxel, mesh, and z prediction heads
configure_roi_z_head: set up the ROI z prediction head with FastRCNNFCHead pooling resolution and smooth L1 loss parameters
configure_roi_voxel_head: configure the ROI voxel head with VoxelRCNNConvUpsampleHead convolution dimensions and depth channel settings
configure_roi_mesh_head: set up the ROI mesh head with MeshRCNNGraphConvHead graph convolution stages and chamfer loss weights
review_cfg_defaults: review the Mesh R-CNN configuration defaults for voxel mesh and z prediction head settings
